title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Organism Specific Culture Detection

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Specific determination: Targeted culture detection — organism specific culture technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Threshold presence of a named organism by organism specific culture (MRSA/VRE/Salmonella screening cultures). Contains 13316-5. Parts: LOINC enumeration (191, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (1), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (118589004 |Threshold (property) (qualifier value)| OR 705057003 |Presence (property) (qualifier value)|), 246501002 |Technique (attribute)| = << 703752003 |Organism specific culture technique (qualifier value)|`

purpose.value: Guidance for binding Observation.code of the MII microbiology request profiles to a computably defined LOINC set; accompanies ballot comments on 2027.0.0-ballot2. Generated, not hand-curated.
